correctness.rationale: Exact tridiagonal Gram inverse s q^|i-j| satisfies all recurrence equations. The explicit single-jump coefficient sequence is tested in the Gram system; its full sum of absolute consecutive differences gives the three analytic pieces, all <= sqrt(3) with equality at knots. Signed-measure jump decomposition bounds every finite-BV input and two separated step gradients prove sharpness in compact-support L2. The standalone independent exact arithmetic checks test 21 finite-system cases and 119 moment equations; no finite test substitutes for the infinite arguments.

value.rationale: The exact sharp BV operator gain and complete subcell jump profile resolve a natural stability question for the foundational uniform L2 finite-element spline projector. They reveal that a nonlocal least-squares smoothing operator has amplification sqrt(3) while related positive local interpolants are variation diminishing, with exact alignment of worst discontinuities at knots. The statement is distinct from kernel L-infinity norm tables and has direct relevance to discontinuity-bearing approximation.
